import pytest
from datetime import date
from late_fee import LateFeeCalculator

def test_balance_zero():
    assert LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,2,1)).compute_fee_cents(0, date(2024,1,1)) == 0

def test_balance_negative():
    assert LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,2,1)).compute_fee_cents(-100, date(2024,1,1)) == 0

def test_within_grace():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,1,10))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,1)) == 0

def test_end_before_start():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,1,1))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,10)) == 0

def test_min_fee_applied():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,1,17))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(100, date(2024,1,1)) == 500

def test_normal_fee_rounding():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,2,1))
    fee = c.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024,1,1))
    assert fee > 500

def test_max_fee_cap():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2025,1,1))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(1000, date(2024,1,1)) == 250

def test_weekend_exclusion():
    c = LateFeeCalculator(date(2024,1,15))
    days = c._weekday_days_between(date(2024,1,1), date(2024,1,15))
    assert days == 10

def test_default_today():
    c = LateFeeCalculator()
    assert c._today == date.today()
